name: Deus Café
description: is a popular, multi-concept venue and restaurant located in Canggu, Bali, part of the larger Deus Ex Machina Temple of Enthusiasm. It blends custom motorcycles, surf culture, art and apparel with all-day dining from breakfast through dinner in a vibrant, creative setting.
priceRange: Mains & dinner plates approx Rp 150.000 – Rp 300.000; cocktails & beer from Rp 65.000++
